response_payload.rationale_summary: The compare operation was applied to the two specified Finance records (US industrial production index for 2009-03-01 and 2009-04-01) in input order. The first attempt returned a typed selector refinement error; after revising the selector, the operation succeeded. The difference is 0.7184, and the higher reference is the April 2009 record, as verified by cross-check evidence.
